title: Ze’ira (I)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sotah 25a: “Rabbi Yoshiyah said: Ze’ira told me three things in the name of the people of Jerusalem; and when I came to my colleagues in the South,” etc. In the Jerusalem Talmud there, 4:2: “Rabbi Yoshiyah said: Ze’ira told me in the name of the people of Jerusalem.” In Sifrei, Ki Tetze: “Ze’ira told me in the name of the people of Jerusalem; and when I came and presented it before Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira,” etc. Hyman infers from this that he was early. And what we find in Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2, “Rabbi Ze’ira asked Rabbi Yoshiyah,” Hyman proposes “Rabbi Hoshaya.”

notes.text: The early dating and Hoshaya-for-Yoshiyah correction are Hyman’s inference and proposal. The nested Ze’ira/Yoshiyah/Beteira report and source/title distinctions remain intact.

The inspected Sotah 25a explicitly gives Yoshiyah reporting Ze’ira’s three teachings from the people of Jerusalem. The dating inference, Sifrei wording and proposed Hoshaya correction remain Hyman’s; the named occurrence does not establish every Ze’ira as one person.
